title: Dealer positioning predicts Treasury returns (NY Fed, dealer balance-sheet share and expected returns): CFTC TFF dealers in ZN/ZB
signal: x = (Dealer long - Dealer short) / open interest, weekly per ZN and ZB; z = 156-week z-score (min 104); effective report + 6 days (gen119 weekly_to_daily)
rule: long the contract when z > th (dealers heavily long: compensation for warehousing), short when z < -th, else flat; 0.10 / vol / 2 each
